evidence.V1: Reads as a crate from all angles: front shows the frame and 4 plank rows, top shows the lid planks, three-quarter shows both; outline is symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0). But the silhouette is a plain cube where the corner caps barely break the outline, so it is generic at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Clear three tiers: the cube mass (big), the frame rails/posts and recessed planks with dark gaps (medium), and the steel corner caps (small). The small tier is limited to the 8 caps.
evidence.V3: Proportions are safe and close to a real crate: an almost exact cube (2.39 x 2.39 x 2.42) with thin posts and rails about 1/12 of the width. Only the chunky caps are exaggerated, so it is partly stylised rather than confidently stylised.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on the plank edges, rounded rails, and bevelled steel caps all catch a highlight in the corner and planks studio close-ups. No razor edges and nothing blobby.
evidence.V5: Close-ups are clean, with no pinches, seams, z-fighting or stray faceting. The plank ends meet the posts cleanly and the caps sit flush (seats show 0 gap, 0.02-0.07 penetration). The 1454 cross-shell overlaps are intentional interpenetration and none of them show.
evidence.V6: One warm-brown wood hue in about 3 values (alternating light and dark lid planks, mid sides, dark gaps) plus steel-grey caps. Disciplined, but the frame and side planks are almost the same value in flat light.
evidence.V7: 1148 tris against the medium class target of 2000 (ceiling 4000).
evidence.V8: One white material (LF_VertexColor) with vertex colours, steel-grey accents, chamfers in line with the kit, and smooth shading. The walnut, teal, crimson and royal colourways swap cleanly on the same mesh.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct for static scenery: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin at bottom-centre.

artifacts: none visible; 1454 cross-shell overlaps are intentional interpenetration (planks into core 0.07, caps into posts 0.02) with no z-fighting in the close-ups
low value contrast between frame rails/posts and side planks (seen best in the flat close-up)
top_fixes: Make the frame bolder and more stylised: thicker posts and rails, and caps that stick out further, to break up the cube outline and get V3 to 2
Separate the frame value from the side-plank value (darker or lighter frame) so the structure reads at a distance
Add one small-scale read, such as nail heads on the rail and plank crossings or a diagonal brace on one face, to enrich the small tier and the silhouette
